_readme: Visual briefs for every Artificer item (#1673, epic #1672), keyed by item id: the store goods (region1.ts Stores), every recipe result (region1.ts), the items with effects (crafting.ts DEFAULT_EFFECTS), the hike kit (kit.ts) and the manuals (techniques.ts). brief = silhouette, material, colour, one telling detail; tier 0 = an icon, tier 1 = an inspect card first, then the icon redrawn to match; icon = the 32 px icon's URL under public/, once there is one. art-briefs.test.ts fails when an item has no brief. How to add one: docs/art-pipeline.md.

rawFood.brief: A small heap of raw food on a leaf: a gutted fish, a hare's haunch and a twist of red lingonberries; silver, pink and red; a drop of blood on the leaf.

water.brief: A shallow wooden bowl brimming with clear stream water; brown rim, pale blue water with a white glint; the water's surface catching the light.

firewood.brief: A short cut log lying on its side, the end-grain toward the viewer; dark brown bark, warm tan rings; a split running into the rings.

materials.brief: A bundle of crafting stuff bound with fibre: straight sticks, a hank of plant fibre and a flint flake; browns and straw yellow; the knot at the binding.

rations.brief: A cloth-wrapped travel ration tied crosswise with string; oatmeal cloth, dark twine; a strip of dried meat poking out at one end.

stone.brief: A pile of grey quarried stones, flat-faced and angular; cool greys, lit on the top edges; one stone shows a fresh pale split face.

hides.brief: A raw deer hide spread roughly square with leg tabs; tawny fur side, cream flesh side; a white patch of fur at one edge.

stone-knife.brief: A short knife, a knapped flint blade lashed into a wooden handle; grey flint, brown wood, tan sinew wrapping; the flaked scallops along the edge.

skinning-knife.brief: A skinning knife with a wide curved belly and a bone handle; dark grey stone blade, cream bone; the blade hooking up at the tip.

trap-snare.brief: A snare: a loop of twisted cord tied to a bent trigger stick; straw-brown cord, darker wood; the running knot at the loop.

waterskin.brief: A rounded hide water bag with a wooden stopper and a carrying thong; tan leather, a darker stitched seam; a bead of water at the spout.

bedroll.brief: A rolled sleeping mat of woven grass and fur tied with two cords; straw and brown fur; the frayed grass ends at the roll's mouth.

crude-shovel.brief: A flat wooden blade lashed to a straight pole; weathered brown wood, tan lashing; a clod of dark earth on the blade's edge.

fishing-rod.brief: A thin bent birch rod with a line and a bone hook; pale wood, grey line; the hook dangling at the line's end.

pouch.brief: A small drawstring pouch of soft leather cinched at the neck; warm brown; a bone toggle on the drawstring.

basket.brief: A round woven basket with one arched handle; straw and willow tones; the over-under weave clearly visible.

backpack.brief: A hide pack on a frame of sticks, its flap tied down; brown leather on pale wood; the frame's sticks poking out above the flap.

harness.brief: A pulling harness of hide straps crossing in an X; dark leather, tan rawhide; the wooden toggle where the straps meet.

sled.brief: A low wooden sled, two runners with lashed crosspieces; pale wood, tan lashings; the runners' curled-up front tips.

cold-gear.brief: Layered winter clothes folded in a stack: a woven hooded tunic over fur leggings; oatmeal wool, brown fur; the fur trim round the hood.

hide-parka.brief: A hooded parka of stitched hides with the fur turned in; tawny leather, cream fur at the hood and cuffs; the stitched seam down the front.

cold-pit.brief: A round pit lined with flat stones, half covered by a lid of poles; grey stone, dark earth, brown poles; cold blue shadow inside.

shelter-leanto.brief: A lean-to: poles leant on a ridge pole and thatched with spruce boughs; brown poles, dark green boughs; the open side facing the viewer.

shelter-hut.brief: A dome-shaped brush hut of bent saplings packed with brush; browns and dull greens; a low dark doorway.

shelter-timber.brief: A small hut with log walls and a bough roof; brown timber, green roof; the log ends crossing at a notched corner.

shelter-stone.brief: A hut with stone banked waist-high against its timber walls; grey stone, brown logs, green roof; a wisp of smoke from the roof.

mora-knife.brief: A scout's sheath knife: short bright steel blade, a red-painted birch handle, its black sheath beside it; the red handle is the tell.

fire-steel.brief: A fire steel on a cord with its scraper: a dark grey rod in a black handle; a spray of orange sparks off the tip.

matches.brief: A small matchbox inside a clear zip bag; red-tipped matches spilling from the box; the bag's zip seal along the top.

first-aid-kit.brief: A small zip pouch with a white cross; red fabric, white cross; a plaster's tab peeking out of the zip.

water-bottle.brief: A metal water bottle with a screw cap on a loop; dull aluminium grey, blue cap; a dent in its side.

kasa.brief: A carved birch drinking cup with one side handle; pale honey-coloured wood; a leather thong looped through the handle's hole.

thermos.brief: A tall steel thermos with its cup-lid off; green body, silver cap; a wisp of steam from the open top.

sleeping-bag.brief: A sleeping bag packed in its stuff sack; dark green nylon, black cord lock; the quilted baffles showing at the open end.

sleeping-pad.brief: A foam sleeping pad rolled up and strapped; blue foam with a ridged surface; the spiral of the roll at one end.

sit-pad.brief: A square foam sit pad on a cord; bright orange foam; the cord loop at one corner.

wool-underlayer.brief: A folded long-sleeved wool top; grey-blue knit; a ribbed cuff on the folded sleeve.

hat-mittens.brief: A knitted wool hat beside a pair of mittens; red with a white pattern band; the pompom on the hat.

rain-gear.brief: A folded rain jacket with its hood on top; bright yellow, glossy; the drawcord at the hood.

spare-socks.brief: A rolled pair of thick wool socks; grey with a red stripe at the top; the bump of the heel.

headlamp.brief: A headlamp on an elastic strap; black lamp body, orange strap; a pale yellow beam from the lens.

map-compass.brief: A folded orienteering map with a baseplate compass on it; pale map with green and brown contours, clear compass; the red north needle.

whistle.brief: A plastic whistle on a lanyard; orange whistle, black cord; the round chamber of the whistle.

cord.brief: A coil of cord, wound and tied off; tan; a loose end hanging free.

tarp.brief: A folded tarp with its guylines; green nylon; a metal grommet at one corner.

trangia.brief: A nesting spirit stove: stacked aluminium pots with a folding handle; silver grey; a small blue flame ring at the base.

weekend-food.brief: A paper bag of hike food: crispbread, a wedge of cheese and a tin of meatballs; tan, yellow and a red-labelled tin; the crispbread's dotted surface.

sweets.brief: A small paper bag of loose sweets with its top twisted shut; striped paper, bright candy colours; one sweet spilled out.

notebook.brief: A small notebook with a pencil tucked under its elastic; brown card cover; the yellow pencil.

toilet-paper.brief: A roll of toilet paper in a plastic bag; white roll, clear bag; the bag's knotted top.

phone.brief: A smartphone with a dark, dead screen; black glass, grey edge; a crack across one corner.

comic.brief: A well-thumbed comic book with a loose cover; bright yellow and red cover with a cartoon bear; a torn corner.

pillow.brief: A small camp pillow; blue-and-white striped cotton; a dent where a head lay.

tally-book.brief: A trapper's tally-book: a small leather-bound book; dark brown leather, cream pages, worn corners; the thick, much-handled cover.

forester-notes.brief: A forester's notes: loose bark-coloured pages tied with cord; tan and brown; a charcoal sketch of a notched log on the top page.

family-tent.brief: A huge rolled family tent in its stuff sack, far too big for a scout; faded orange nylon, green poles poking out; a frayed drawstring.

home-pillow.brief: A big soft bed pillow folded in half; white cotton case with small blue flowers; squashed where it was strapped to a pack.

salsa.brief: A big glass jar of chunky red salsa with a screw lid; red and green chunks, a yellow label; a spoon handle stuck in the top.

big-bag-sweets.brief: A giant crumpled sweet bag, nearly empty; shiny foil in bright colours; only a few green sweets left at the bottom.

rice.brief: A plump paper bag of rice, folded over at the top; pale brown paper, white grains; a few grains spilling from a corner.

rubber-boots.brief: A pair of tall wellington boots; glossy dark green rubber, black soles; a splash of mud up one leg.

hammer.brief: A full-size claw hammer; worn wooden handle, grey steel head; a strip of tape wound round the grip.

hairdryer.brief: A plastic hairdryer with its cord coiled round the handle; pastel pink; the plug dangling with nowhere to go.

dumbbells.brief: Two small iron dumbbells side by side; black iron bells, silver bars; one has a chipped edge.

flamingo.brief: A deflated pool flamingo folded into a flat bundle; bright pink plastic, a yellow beak; the long neck flopping over.

binoculars.brief: A pair of old binoculars on a leather strap; black body, brass trim; light glinting on one lens.

duct-tape.brief: A half-used roll of duct tape; dull silver tape, cardboard core; a torn end curling off the roll.

sewing-kit.brief: A small round tin sewing kit, lid open; tin with a floral print, reels of thread in many colours; a needle stuck in a pincushion.

magnifying-glass.brief: A round magnifying glass with a handle; brass rim, black handle; a bright spot of sunlight in the lens.

bird-book.brief: A small field guide to birds, well thumbed; green cloth cover with a white bird on it; a pencil tucked in as a bookmark.

throat-sweets.brief: A small flat tin of hard throat sweets, lid ajar; red and white tin, amber sweets inside; a sweet rolled out.

lots-of-socks.brief: A tall heap of rolled-up socks; grey wool, red heels and toes; one stray sock unrolled on top.

notebook-pencils.brief: A squared notebook with a fan of coloured pencils beside it; white grid paper, rainbow pencils; a little sketch on the open page.

harmonica.brief: A small harmonica seen side-on; shiny chrome cover, wooden comb; a row of square holes.

board-game.brief: A battered board-game box, lid half off; red cardboard, a folded board inside; a few pieces and a die spilling out.

pickled-herring.brief: A glass jar of pickled herring with a tight metal lid; silver fish in clear brine, onion rings; a blue-and-white label.

toy-duck.brief: A small rubber toy duck; bright yellow body, orange beak; a chewed tail.

garden-gnome.brief: A painted garden gnome standing upright; red pointed hat, white beard, blue coat; a chipped nose.

snow-globe.brief: A snow globe on a round base; clear glass dome, a tiny red cottage inside; white flakes swirling.

roller-skate.brief: A single old roller skate; white boot, four red wheels; the laces trailing loose.

alarm-clock.brief: A wind-up alarm clock with twin bells on top; red metal case, white face; the hammer caught between the bells.

dala-horse.brief: A carved wooden dala horse; bright red paint, white and green flowers on its saddle; a small chip on one ear.

sock-puppet.brief: A sock puppet with button eyes; striped blue wool sock; one eye sewn on slightly crooked.

smooth-stones.brief: A little pile of smooth, flat beach stones; grey and speckled, worn round; one striped with white quartz.

accordion.brief: A red piano accordion, half open; red pearl body, white keys, black bellows; a worn leather strap.
